changes: Use the same Node-stream transport on Node 24 and Bun, retaining SDK callback and lazy download APIs.
Enforce a total deadline through redirects and response bodies; propagate cancellation to connections and upload streams.
Serialize arbitrary multipart parts in order, end string-only uploads and cancel stalled input streams.
Snapshot mutable headers, byte views and pool options; append query parameters to existing queries; sanitize request errors.
Bound and isolate agent caching by protocol, proxy and pool configuration; enable proxy keep-alive for forever requests.
Preserve per-request statistics across resetStats and add response-size limits.
upstreamTestAdaptations: Await callback and stream assertions before teardown; correct proxy constructor imports in the test file.
Supply HTTPS metadata to Nock on Bun, equally for both implementations; real HTTP/TLS tests run without that shim.
Retain two skipped upstream multipart tests and add real-network multipart regressions.
Require the published Node control to reproduce exactly its two error-message/compression-header assertion failures.
